away.summary: The New York Islanders are coming off a 6-0 victory over the New Jersey Devils, with Victor Eklund scoring his first NHL goal on his 20th birthday. The team is projected to have a new-look lineup, with several players stepping up offensively. Ilya Sorokin is confirmed to start in goal.

home.summary: The New York Rangers are riding a three-game winning streak, including a 4-2 victory over the Utah Mammoth. They are undefeated at home this season and have a strong offensive presence. The team is projected to have a solid lineup, with Vladislav Gavrikov, Eeli Tolvanen, Gabe Perreault, and J.T. Miller all contributing offensively. Nico Daws is expected to start in goal.
